# Voice Control triggers

## Command

Runs when you say one of your Voice Control commands into the microphone, like "scene gaming". You set up the spoken phrases on the Voice Control page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Voice Control** | The name of a voice command from the Voice Control page. Several names can be separated by commas. Any means every command. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voiceCommandName%` | The name of the command that was heard |
| `%spokenCommand%` | The phrase of the command |
| `%spokenTextInput%` | What you said after the command phrase (for commands that listen at the start) |
| `%spokenText%` | Everything that was heard |
| `%voiceCommandConfidencePercent%` | How sure Cuebot is that it heard right, 0 to 100 |

<small>Type id: `voiceControl.command`</small>

## Dictation

Runs for everything you say, once you finish a sentence, even when it is not a command. Good for turning speech into text on your stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Voice Control** | Only react when the sentence also contained this voice command (name from the Voice Control page, commas for several). Any means every sentence. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%spokenText%` | Everything that was heard in the sentence |
| `%spokenTextConfidencePercent%` | How sure Cuebot is that it heard right, 0 to 100 |
| `%spokenLanguage%` | The language that was heard |
| `%voiceCommandName%` | The name of the first command in the sentence (empty if none) |
| `%voiceCommandCount%` | How many commands were in the sentence |

<small>Type id: `voiceControl.dictation`</small>
